title: Points Worksheet for Retroactive Claims on Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements
content:
**Worksheet.** A retroactive claim under Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements credits company points and agreement-year spend for one flown segment of a ticket the company booked without the agreement. The figures are worked line by line from the claimed ticket's record in Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand:

| Line | Figure | How it is obtained |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Base fare | the base fare on the claimed ticket, as paid |
| 2 | Segments sharing the fare | 1 for a one-way ticket, 2 for a round trip |
| 3 | Shared base fare | line 1 divided by line 2, rounded to the cent |
| 4 | Claim spend | the shared base fare as paid (line 3) |
| 5 | Claim points | line 4 multiplied by the tier's points per dollar, rounded down to the whole point |

The claim credits the claim points of line 5 as the segment's points entry and the claim spend of line 4 as its spend entry.

### Worked lines (hypothetical tickets)

| | Round-trip ticket | One-way ticket |
|---|---|---|
| Line 1, base fare (USD) | 700.00 | 289.99 |
| Line 2, segments | 2 | 1 |
| Line 3, shared base fare (USD) | 350.00 | 289.99 |
| Line 4, claim spend (USD) | 350.00 | 289.99 |
| Tier's points per dollar | 2 | 1.5 |
| Line 5, claim points | 700 | 434 (434.985 rounded down) |

### Points of judgement

- The base fare excludes taxes and fees, which never enter the claim spend.
- A round-trip ticket shares its base fare equally between its 2 segments, whichever segment is claimed.
